reference: composite reference: Newson-Krumm (2009) equations 1-3; scipy.stats.norm/expon; shapely.STRtree/line_locate_point; networkx.single_source_dijkstra/all_shortest_paths

source.selection: four northing-stratified shortest paths, complete full-graph candidate-radius and directed-route neighborhoods

conventions.leuven: not equivalent: squared transition and extra penalties

tolerances.derivation: Distance atol=max(1e-6*coordinateScale,8*ulp32(coordinateScale)); fraction atol=max(1e-6,8*ulp32(coordinateScale)/minimumEdgeLength). Inputs rounded before Shapely/NetworkX. IDs, tie membership, breaks and overflow exact.
